summary: An eight-voice virtual analog synth in the style of the Roland JP-8000 and JP-8080, ported from the JT-8000 engine with its behaviour measured against the original. In development, not yet released.
features: Super Saw and other JP oscillator types; JP-style LPF, BPF and HPF
Multi-effects, stereo delay, plate reverb and output limiter
Poly, mono and unison; upper and lower parts as layer or split
Two-track real-time sequencer with piano roll; 14-mode arpeggiator
64 programs; USB MIDI in and out, TRS in, JP-8080 CCs
Browser page to load JP-8000/8080 SysEx patches over USB
